Fighter Justin Gaethje and coach Trevor Wittman headline Rogan's MMA Show number 181. Gaethje is famed for violent, crowd-pleasing fights. Wittman is the calm mind in his corner.

Rogan breaks down Gaethje's style with the pair who built it. They explain how a wild brawler learned control and craft. Stories of knockouts and hard lessons fill the talk. The episode gives fight fans a rare dual view: the man who throws the shots and the coach who calls them, side by side. Trust between fighter and coach anchors it all.

Video star MrBeast joins Joe Rogan for episode 2527. His real name is Jimmy Donaldson, and his stunts draw huge crowds online. He gives away large sums as part of his shows.

Rogan asks how the empire of videos and brands was built. Donaldson explains the grind behind each viral hit. They talk about money, fame, and staying sane under both. The episode lets a very online star speak at length, off script. Young fans and curious parents alike get the full story of a new kind of celebrity. The scale of his reach still stuns both men.

Rob O'Neill, the Navy SEAL credited with killing Osama bin Laden, shares shocking stories from SEAL Team 6 with Tucker Carlson. O'Neill's years in the elite unit took him through America's hardest missions. Here he also tells politicians what they should know before starting wars.

O'Neill recounts missions and losses that shaped his view of combat and command. He argues that leaders who never served send troops too easily into long wars. Carlson asks about the bin Laden raid and the fame that followed it. Patriots and the curious get straight talk from the man at the tip of the spear.
